BHAVYA Scheme Receives 87 Proposals for Industrial Parks

The Indian government's Rs 33,660 crore BHAVYA Scheme has received 87 proposals in the first round of its Phase-1. The scheme aims to establish 100 industrial parks across India. This marks the initial phase of the initiative.
